get.summary:
Bytes go out with the type fixed at registration, never sniffed, and sandboxed so
a file opened directly cannot act as a page on this origin.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words to find; quotes, `or` and `-word` work as in a web search.

parameters.name: ended
parameters.description: True lists tasks that were removed from the board.

column_id.description: Omit to use the first column matching the task's status, or the first column.

oneOf.description: Or create a new shared task; a column's status applies to it.

task_id.description: Link an existing shared task; its status is left as it is.

reminder_minutes.description: Zero disables attendee reminder mail. Otherwise 1–10080 minutes before start.

code.description: One-time code. Display it to its owner; never put it in URLs or logs.

Board.description: Columns and the cards this member can see; hidden tasks are not counted anywhere.

assignee_in_project.description: False when Tasks assigned this to someone outside the project.

column_id.description: Null once the task was removed from the board.

position.description: Place among the cards this member can see, so it reveals nothing hidden.

CliSession.description: A first-party Auth session for the CLI/MCP. The refresh token rotates.

oneOf.description: Moving a card here asks Tasks for this status; null changes nothing.

blocks.description: Typed blocks parsed from the source; the only form to render.

body.description: Plain source in the rich text subset; empty once removed.

mine.description: The calling member wrote this comment.

equals.description: Option keys, or `true`/`false` for a checkbox.

expected_version.description: Omitted for the first configuration of a form's recipe.

allow_shared.description: Explicitly reviewed creation of a different person sharing identifiers.

oneOf.description: Absent for members who cannot read drafts.

unpublished_changes.description: The draft differs from what is published.

file_archived.description: Archiving the file in Files also withdraws it from public pages.

fields.description: The content type's fields when this revision was made.

public_key.description: Public read rights for this type's published entries only.

device_label.description: Caller-reported device name, shown for recognition only.

deal_id.description: Only for members who can read that deal.

project_id.description: Only for members who can read that project.

state.description: queued or completed; failures are job states.

activated_by_membership_id.description: Member whose current permissions each run uses.

include_deal_owner.description: Add the deal's owner to the project.

name_prefix.description: Project names read `prefix: deal title`; empty uses the deal title alone.

status_id.description: The deal status that marks the milestone.

Delivery.description:
Delivery view over the project's visible tasks, soonest deadline first. The
summary and workload cover every visible task; filters narrow only `items`.

today.description: The installation's current date, which deadlines are compared with.

due_soon.description: Unfinished work due within the next seven days.

past_project_deadline.description: Unfinished work due after the project's own deadline.

oneOf.description: Shown only when an earlier choice or checkbox answer matches.

options.description: Choice and checkbox counts; empty for free-text questions.

unpublished_changes.description: The draft differs from the published version.

document_count.description: Active documents; anyone who sees the collection may see all of them.

is_member.description: The calling member is listed on this collection.

restricted.description: Reachable only through its member list or the explicit override.

blocks.description: Typed blocks parsed from `body`; renderers use only these.

body.description: Plain source in the rich text subset.

linked.description: Documents this one links to, as far as the reader may see them.

KnowledgeLinkPreview.description:
What a reader may learn about a linked document. Absent means the same whether
the target is hidden, in another workspace or does not exist.

collection_id.description: The collection the document was in when this revision was made.

total.description: All matches this reader may see, across pages.

KnowledgeSnippetPart.description: One stretch of a snippet; matched words are marked by structure, never markup.

Mapping.description: Explicit field mapping using stable field keys of the published version.

name_fields.description: Up to three short-text answers joined to form the contact name.

phone_country.description: Default region for phone answers without a country code, such as `US`.

resolved.description: Explicitly resolved fields; all identifiers on both records are retained.

before_card_id.description: Place the card before this one; null places it last.

is_member.description: The calling member belongs to this project.

source_deal_id.description: The deal this project was converted from, only for members who can read that deal.

submission_key.description: Client-generated retry key: 16–128 visible ASCII characters.

oneOf.description:
`public_key` is absent while the form cannot be answered, including while
the Forms application is disabled; the page explains rather than breaks.

activated_by_membership_id.description: Member whose current permissions each run uses.

move_cards_to.description: Every card in the column moves to the end of this column, unchanged.

dropped_fields.description:
Values left out because their field no longer exists with the same kind.
They remain readable in the revision.

state.description: queued, awaiting_review, completed or dismissed; failures are job states.

expected_version.description: Required for updates; omitted on creation.

position.description: Zero-based place on the board; omitted keeps it, or adds at the end.

expected_version.description: Required for updates; omitted on creation.
Required for updates; omitted on creation.

Required for updates; omitted on creation.

assigned_membership_id.description: A new assignee must belong to the project.

expected_task_version.description: The shared task's version, as read from the card.

oneOf.description: Omit to keep the task's status.

answers.description: Original visible answers keyed by stable field keys.

public_url.description:
Browser origin for sign-in approval; may differ from the API address a
local client uses. Absent from older servers.

type_id.description: Omit to preserve the type on edit; null explicitly clears it.
